set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWY8W7DP7TBKH918WVRG20YW. Problem: PipelineRun can read by ArtifactRef but a working pipeline system needs named outputs. Add typed output accessors such as output/getOutput/requireOutput with clear errors for missing output names and artifact kind mismatches. Acceptance: outputs can be read by PortName; errors are structured PipelineError values; JVM/JS tests cover missing name, kind mismatch, and successful typed read.
set.title: Pipeline: add typed named output access
